orientation_key: W0 = north end (service/loading side, faces the old DC bridge lane, now the M4 site); W1-W7 = west side facing SLC (W1/W2 NW stair tower, W3 long west face, W4-W6 SW tower, W7 = SW main entrance under the QNC bridge); W8 = south face toward QNC/C2 plaza; W9-W11 = SE block and tower; W12 = long east face over the east lawn; W13-W17 = NE tower cluster. Long axis runs NNW-SSE (bearing ~339).

main_wall.where: board-formed / precast warm light-grey concrete on every wall face, parapet, fascia bands (sunlit W9 pier #d3cfcc, flat c2012 band #a7a2a1, overcast uw003 #837f73; midday average ~#b9b4aa; paving 1.0 and concrete_raw 2.1 Lab away)

hood_fins.where: the projecting window-hood fins, sills and sloped soffits catch the sun and read clearly lighter than the wall (c2012 fins #c3ccdc in blue-sky light, trapezoids #ccd1d7)

fluted_towers.where: vertically fluted stair/service towers; the fine flute shadows darken them vs flat concrete (W9 tower #bfbfbd sunlit, W12 tower #8a7c71 low sun)

brick_infill.where: ground-storey infill between the piers on every side: dark purple-brown brick (W12 sunlit #755e4e, W0 #66585b, W9 shade #574334). roof_mansard is 3.8 away; a semantic alias 'brick_mc' #735f52 would be clearer but is not needed

glass.where: all windows; hood windows usually show pale curtains so a slightly lighter blue-grey (#6c7f9c c2012, panel_navy 5.2) also works

recessed_frames.where: dark bronze/black frames of the recessed level-3 glazing and the entrance storefronts

soffit_shadow.where: underside of the overhang above the brick, inside of pier bays

stair_guard.where: solid dark brown metal guard panel on the exterior stair at the NW tower (sv_W0_S1Bw)

red_steel.where: portal frames of the MC-DC bridge at the NE corner (2014 SV; demolished 2024-25). Same colour DC's spec measured

qnc_bridge_glass.where: blue-grey glass of the QNC bridge behind its horizontal silver louvres (metal_silver)

pink_tie.where: giant pink tie banner on the NW stair tower (2002 photo); a recurring display, absent in 2014 SV and Earth

W0.summary: north end: two continuous bands of 33 hooded windows over a plain fascia with a row of small windows, a 7 m ground storey of dark brick between 9 square concrete piers with splayed (stepped-corbel) heads; loading dock with a roller door at the east end, a free-standing low fluted-concrete service annex in front (s 12-32), the NW fluted stair tower at the west end with an exterior concrete stair

hood.soffit: the window box's underside slopes from 0.65 m out at the sill back to the wall face ~1.1 m lower: reads as a pale trapezoid under every window (sawtooth shadow line in raking light)

hood/*.note: tall narrow window, dark glass, often pale curtains/blinds behind (reads mid grey-blue); thin dark frame; the fins between windows are the hood sides and read near-white in sun

l3/k.note: small square-ish window high in the plain fascia, one every second hood module (3.0 m pitch), little projecting eyebrow

ground/h.note: dark purple-brown brick infill flush to the underside of the overhang; set ~0.5 m behind the pier faces; one bronze wall-pack light per pier bay at ~3.5 m

ground/k.note: dark purple-brown brick infill flush to the underside of the overhang; set ~0.5 m behind the pier faces; one bronze wall-pack light per pier bay at ~3.5 m

overhang.note: everything above the ground storey cantilevers ~1.4 m beyond the brick; pier faces stand ~0.5 m proud of the brick

W0.pier_shape: square ~1.2 m concrete piers with horizontal panel joints every ~1.5 m; at the top they splay out under the overhang in 2-3 stepped corbel blocks (commons piers detail 2013), which Earth smooths into curved haunches that read like a row of shallow arches (earth_W0_whole)

towers.what: north face of the NW fluted stair tower (continues on W1/W2): blank vertically fluted concrete, flutes ~0.1 m pitch, horizontal joints every ~1.5 m; a door at +1.6 m reached by an exterior concrete stair (8-9 steps, rising west to east along the tower face) with a solid dark brown metal guard panel; a wall-pack light above the door

attached: 2014-2024: the MC-DC bridge left just east of the a end (NE corner) heading east/north-east; demolished Nov 2024-Jan 2025
2025-2026: the M4 site starts at the a end (2026 ortho); M4 may abut the east part of this wall (unconfirmed)

notes: All Street View of MC is Sep 2014 (campus trekker) - nothing from 2023-2025 in the folder; Google 3D predates the DC bridge demolition. The 2026 spring ortho and the 2024-26 M4 construction diary are the only post-2024 sources. Universal section (from sv_W3_lNDV, earth_facade_3, commons c2012): parapet ~2.5 m; two hood storeys ~3.3 m each (window 2.0 m tall between near-white fins at 1.5 m pitch, pale sloped soffit trapezoid under each); plain band; level 3 either recessed glazing (W3, W12) or a fascia with small windows at 3 m pitch (W0, W8); ground zone of dark brick behind square piers at 6.0 m (4 hoods per pier bay), W8 instead has a continuous level-2 balcony parapet and no pier arcade. Fluted towers rise ~4.3 m above the main roof at NW (W1/W2), SW (W4-W6), SE (W10/W11) and NE (W13-W17); flutes are fine (~0.1 m) with horizontal joints every ~1.5 m, and a dark slot window strip sits in each re-entrant. web/mc_m4ctx009 is mislabelled: it shows a tan horizontally banded neighbour behind the M4 frame, not MC.
